newsitem.title: JAPAN: Apple Japan to aim for 16% domestic PC mkt share.
newsitem.headline: Apple Japan to aim for 16% domestic PC mkt share.

text.p: Apple Japan Inc, the Japanese unit of Apple Computer Inc, said on Monday that it would aim for a 16 percent share of the Japanese personal computer market in 1998.

"We have previously held a 16 percent (personal computer) market share and we would like to see that level once again when we introduce Rhapsody," Apple Japan Inc president Eiko Harada told a news conference.
Rhapsody is a next-generation operating system which runs on PCs with Pentium chips from Intel Corp.
Harada also said total shipments of Apple's PCs in 1997 in Japan could fall short of the 700,000 units it shipped in 1996, due to a shortage in its product stocks at the beginning of this year.
